Ex-54363
Need a HSI User

EX - 1737
Log in to T-Mobile https://digital-qlab03.t-mobile.com

Identify a test account with an existing PA set up for the past due amount, where total balance would offer a wider date range

Navigate to the Manage PA screen, click "Edit," and note the current allowed date range for the past due PA

Switch the balance selection from "Past due" to "Total balance" on the Update page

Click on an installment date field to open the date picker

Verify the allowed date range now extends further than the previous past due boundary (up to the third bill due date)

Select a date that was previously unavailable under the past due range but is now available under total balance

Click "Update" and verify the new schedule reflects the expanded date on the Manage PA screen

EX - 1732
Log in to T-Mobile www.t-mobile.com 

Identify a test account with an existing 2-installment PA that is eligible for modification

Navigate to the Manage tab and click "Manage payment arrangement"

Click the "Edit" link next to the Payment Schedule section

Modify the date for Payment 2 by selecting an earlier or later date within the allowed range

Modify the Payment 1 amount by entering a different amount within the allowed range (above the minimum)

Verify the Total amount remains unchanged after adjusting the split between installments

Click "Update" to save the changes

Verify the landing/Manage PA screen reflects the updated dates and amounts
This is sanity test for testgrid
https://t-mobile.atlassian.net/browse/EX-1059

Log in to T-Mobile https://digital-qlab03.t-mobile.com

Identify a test account with an existing PA

Navigate to the Manage PA screen

Locate and click the "Payment arrangement FAQs" link

Verify the FAQ page loads successfully without errors

Verify the FAQ content includes relevant questions and answers about PA modifications (e.g., "Can I change my payment dates?", "What happens if I modify my arrangement?")

Verify the FAQ content is properly formatted, readable, and matches approved content

Navigate back from the FAQ page
User should land on "Privacy Center" page on ANOTHER tab.

User validates the FAQ's page
TDR: any account with a line.

EX-1736
Log in to T-Mobile https://digital-qlab03.t-mobile.com

Click on an installment date field to open the date picker

Verify dates beyond the current bill due date are grayed out / disabled in the calendar

Attempt to select a date that is past the current bill due date

Select a valid date on or before the current bill due date and click "Update"

See Savings on current Bill:

Testcase steps:
Launch https://t-mobile.com
Login with Username and Password
User clicks on "View Bill" tab on Dashboard Page
On Bill Pay Card, User clicks on Make a payment
The User selects "Total balance" on OTP page
User clicks on "Add payment method"
User clicks on "Bank"
User selects "Or enter account details manually"
User enters name in "Name on account"
User enters "125000105" as Routing Number in "Routing number"
User enters "4353434455" as "Account Number"
User enters "4353434455" as "Re-enter account number"
User selects "Account Type" as "Personal - Checking" from the dropdown
User clicks on Continue
User clicks on "Agree & Continue"
User clicks on "Continue"
User clicks on "Pay Now"
Pre requisite: BAN should have Balance Due
